notes: Hydralazine / Hydroxyzine - widely cited LASA pair in institutional safety bulletins
Vinblastine / Vincristine - both chemotherapy, narrow therapeutic index, intrathecal vincristine is fatal
Epinephrine / Ephedrine - both OR pressors stored near each other, ampoules visually similar
Insulin Lispro / Insulin Glargine - similar pen packaging, opposite action profile (rapid vs long)
Hydromorphone / Morphine - opioids, large potency difference, both high-alert
Losartan / Lorazepam - classic ISMP-style confusion pair, different drug classes entirely
Chlorpromazine / Chlorpropamide - antipsychotic vs sulfonylurea, opposite intended effect
